# Worldwide geographic data

Prepared 2026-10-24T21:29:38.073Z. Input SHA-256 digests and exact URLs are recorded in dist/data/coverage.json. Run `node scripts/prepare-data.mjs` to reproduce from the host cache; add `--refresh` to fetch new source snapshots. Raw source files stay in the operating-system temporary cache, outside the published bundle. Node 20+ is sufficient.

GeoJSON downloaded from the maintainers' nvkelso/natural-earth-vector repository. Public domain; multilingual name fields derive from Wikidata CC0. Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Credit: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/ . Modified by selecting/combining records, choosing name alternatives, grouping under included divisions, and omitting duplicate municipality settlement records. Documentation: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/readme.txt .
- Native country names and language metadata: https://github.com/mledoze/countries . Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL): https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/ . Only country-name/language metadata are combined here; this derived database is offered under ODbL 1.0, retaining compatible source attribution.
- China municipality district/county polygons: geoBoundaries CHN ADM3, boundaryID CHN-ADM3-62558664, year represented 2017, pinned repository commit 9469f09. Source: Lee Beryman and OpenStreetMap. Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright . Open Database License 1.0. Credit geoBoundaries, https://www.geoboundaries.org/ . Metadata: https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/CHN/ADM3/ . Source names are joined with GeoNames where possible; polygons are simplified and selected for the four direct municipalities.
- Municipality district names/codes: modood Administrative-divisions-of-China, https://github.com/modood/Administrative-divisions-of-China , MIT license; compiled from National Bureau of Statistics 2023 administrative-division data. Used to reconcile Chinese names and district/county types for the 86 mapped units of Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin and Chongqing; geometry remains the disclosed 2017 snapshot.
- OpenCC-js 1.4.2: https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-js ; MIT code plus Apache-2.0 dictionary data. Used during preparation for full phrase/dictionary Traditional-to-Simplified Chinese conversion (Hong Kong and Taiwan locale converters), then all China labels normalized to simplified Chinese. License and third-party notices are retained in dist/vendor/LICENSE-opencc.txt and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES-opencc.md.
- D3 7.9.0: https://github.com/d3/d3 , ISC license copied into dist/vendor/LICENSE-d3.txt.

## Actual coverage

255 country/territory map units; 4330 first-level divisions; 235663 cities/towns; 358 sourced local units (UK councils/counties and China municipality districts/counties). Canada: 13 provinces/territories. US: 50 states plus District of Columbia, 51 units. Germany: 16 Länder. UK: 4 constituent countries assembled from Natural Earth geonunit boundaries, with source local councils/counties retained beneath each nation, and settlement records assigned by codes or containment. Northern Ireland retains former 26-district source boundaries and is not a current local-government inventory.

This atlas uses the user-selected China grouping of 34 province-level units: 23 provinces including Taiwan, 5 autonomous regions, 4 direct municipalities and 2 special administrative regions (Hong Kong and Macao). The three source map-unit geometries are included in China and their genuine lower divisions are retained. Natural Earth's Paracel Islands pseudo-division is excluded from the division denominator. Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are grouped beneath China according to the requested atlas convention. Their labels are simplified Mandarin Chinese using OpenCC; source English names remain secondary search aids. Settlement records without any sourced Chinese label are omitted: {"HKG":207,"MAC":0,"TWN":1}. All lower administrative identities remain sourced. Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin and Chongqing do not get an artificial duplicate child city. District/county polygons from geoBoundaries, derived from OpenStreetMap and representing 2017, are presented below their municipality. GeoNames names supply local-script alternatives where available. Settlement records are assigned by exact codes or polygon containment, skipping GeoNames' aggregate duplicate ADM2 tier. This is a historical boundary snapshot, not a current official administrative inventory. Empty town coverage is explicit rather than invented.

GeoNames cities500 includes settlements over 500 people and selected administrative seats. It is not all cities/towns. City / town is a neutral settlement label; no uniform population threshold is used to invent official city status. Capital city comes from GeoNames PPLC source codes. Country-first-level->settlement browsing is a geographic shortcut and does not imply every country's legal hierarchy is identical. Only sourced extra local levels are provided.

Natural Earth admin1 is a beta cartographic dataset, omits certain tiny countries, and may lag recent administrative reforms. Labels and counts describe this bundled snapshot. Natural Earth documentation: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-admin-1-states-provinces/ . Native names use available regional-language translations, source names or local-script alternatives; 11026 settlement records require tagged fallback names. Naming and multilingual coverage are not complete. English names remain available for navigation. Seven continent groups include territories; country totals should say countries & territories/map units rather than sovereign states.

## Transformations

Country and subdivision coordinates are rounded to four decimals and generalized using conservative closed-ring Douglas-Peucker simplification, retaining tiny rings and rejecting simplification with changed orientation or more than 15% planar-area loss. Shared borders may have tiny generalization differences; no cadastral/measurement precision is implied. Polygon winding is determined by D3 spherical area, per polygon, rather than assumed from file convention, and normalized for D3 rendering/containment. Original source label points are retained. Admin1 assignment prefers exact GeoNames administrative-code joins, then matching administrative names, then geometric containment; unassigned settlements are omitted wherever a country has divisions, keeping first-level denominators pure. Countries without included divisions have settlement children directly. 777 unassigned settlement records were omitted; per-country counts are recorded in coverage.json. Native country-name metadata and source credits remain in this source repository.

The source snapshot is provided without warranty of accuracy, completeness or timeliness.

Taiwan has 21 mapped local divisions in this Natural Earth snapshot; Lienchiang is not included in that boundary layer. Taoyuan is identified as a Special Municipality, correcting the older source type following its 2014 upgrade: https://english.ey.gov.tw/Page/61BF20C3E89B856/82a96894-3e47-4e47-9dc7-cc4d9a58895d . Counts remain counts of included map records.
